chunks: A group informed me, from Abu Muhammad al-Talakbari, from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Razi, from al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Qummi, who said: Narrated to me Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Banan al-Talhi al-Abi, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abda al-Nisaburi, who said: Narrated to me Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Razi, who said: Narrated to me the reliable Shaykh in the City of Peace (Baghdad), who said:

Ibn Abi Ghanim al-Qazwini and a group of the Shia disputed regarding the successor (al-Khalaf). Ibn Abi Ghanim mentioned that Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) had passed away and there was no successor for him. Then they wrote a letter regarding this and sent it to the Hidden Imam, informing him of their dispute. The reply to their letter came in his handwriting, peace be upon him and his fathers:

In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. May Allah grant us and you safety from misguidance and trials, and bestow upon us and you the spirit of certainty, and protect us and you from the evil of the return. It has reached me that a group among you has doubt in the religion, and what entered them of doubt and bewilderment regarding their leaders (Imams). Our sorrow for this is for you, not for us, and it distressed us in you, not in ourselves, because Allah is with us and we have no need of anyone else. The truth is with us, so whoever stays away from us will not distress us. And we are the handiwork of our Lord, and the creation is after our handiwork.

O you! Why do you waver in doubt and turn back in bewilderment? Have you not heard Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, say: 'O you who believe! Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority from among you'? Or do you not know what the traditions have brought regarding what happens and occurs in your Imams, the past and the remaining ones, peace be upon them? Have you not seen how Allah made for you strongholds to which you retreat, and signs by which you are guided, from Adam (peace be upon him) until the deceased one (Im al-Hasan al-Askari) appeared (peace be upon him)? Whenever a guide (knowledge) disappeared, another guide appeared, and when a star set, another star rose?

When Allah took him to Himself, did you think that Allah Almighty abolished His religion and severed the link between Him and His creation? No, that was not the case, nor will it be, until the Hour comes and the command of Allah appears, though they dislike it. Indeed, the deceased one (peace be upon him) passed away happy and intact, following the path of his fathers (peace be upon them) exactly, step by step. His will and knowledge are with us, and whoever is his successor and who fills his place. No one disputes our position except an unjust sinner, and no one claims it besides us except a denying disbeliever.

And if it were not that the command of Allah Almighty cannot be overpowered, and His secret is not revealed or made public, our right upon you would have become clear to you, such that your intellects would recognize it and remove your doubts. But what Allah willed, happened, and for every term is a record. So fear Allah and submit to us, and refer the matter to us. Upon us is the issuing (of commands) as was upon us the referring (of matters). Do not strive to uncover what has been concealed from you, nor deviate to the right or turn to the left. Make your aim towards us with affection, upon the clear path. I have given you good advice, and Allah is witness over me and you.

And if it were not for what we have of love for your well-being and mercy for you, and concern for you, we would have been busy in our affairs from addressing you, regarding what we have been tested with: the dispute with the stubborn, misguided oppressor who persists in his error, opposing his Lord, calling for what is not his, denying the right of whom Allah made obedience obligatory, the usurping tyrant. And in the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), I have a good example. And the garment of the deeds of the ignorant will cover him, and the disbeliever will know who is the heir of the home (the end of the house).

May Allah protect us and you from perditions and evils, and all calamities and defects by His mercy, for He is the Guardian of that and the Capable of what He wills. And He was and is a Guardian and Protector for us and for you. Peace be upon all the Successors and the Saints and the Believers, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. And may Allah bless Muhammad and his family with a complete peace.

key_terms.النَّاحِيَةُ: The presence of the Hidden Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hadi (a.s.) say about the continuity of Imamate after his death?
ai.summary: This epistle from Imam al-Hadi (a.s.) addresses the specific historical doubt of the Qazwini scholar Ibn Abi Ghannam and the Baghdad Shia regarding the continuity of the Imamate after the death of an Imam. He refutes the notion that the religion is cut off by affirming the principle of 'every time a light disappears, another light appears,' ensuring the divine proof remains on earth until the Day of Judgment. The letter underscores that the deceased Imam's knowledge and will are preserved within the succeeding Imams, urging believers to submit to their authority rather than prematurely seeking to uncover the hidden details of the Imamate.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 245 - Informed me a group of scholars from Abu Muhammad Talakbari from Ahmad bin Ali Raazi from Husain bin Ali Qummi that he said: Narrated to me Muhammad bin Ali bin Banan Talhi Aabi from Ali bin Muhammad bin Abduh Nishapuri: Narrated to me Ali bin Ibrahim Raazi that he said: A reliable Shaykh said in Baghdad that:

Ibn Abi Ghanim Qazwini along with some Shia people had a difference of opinion regarding the successorship of His Eminence, Imam Hasan Askari (a.s). So much so that Qazwini denied the existence of His Eminence, the Awaited Imam (a.s). However, others stressed that the successor of His Eminence was present and he is His Eminence, Imam Mahdi (a.s). They wrote a letter to the Awaited Imam and related their discussion with Qazwini. His Eminence replied as follows:

In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. May the Almighty Allah keep you and us safe from the mischiefs and may He bestow you and us with certainty and may He also protect you and us from bad consequences. Information regarding doubt and denial of a group from you in religion and matter of guardianship (Wilayat) has reached us. Our sorrow and anger is for you and not for our own selves, as the Almighty Allah is with us, therefore except for Him, we are not needful of anyone else and the truth is with us. Therefore, I am not afraid if someone turns away from us. And we are the first creations of our Lord and (other) creatures and people were created afterwards.

And you, O people! Why have you fallen into doubt and bewilderment? Have you not heard the statement of Almighty Allah: “O you who believe! Obey Allah and obey the Apostle and those in authority from among you…” [4:59] Don’t you know that it has come in traditional reports that unforeseen events had befallen the past and would befall the remaining Imams? Have you not seen how in all the times, the Almighty Allah had made a refuge for you to seek protection in? He appointed torches of guidance from the time of Adam (a.s) till Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) that you may obtain guidance and direction, in such a way that whenever a guide went away, another one took up his place and torch.

When the Almighty Allah took away Imam Hasan Askari (a.s), do you think He has rendered His religion invalid and severed His relation with the creatures? Never! Till the Day of Judgment and the time of the issue of Allah’s command, which is not in favor of the people, it cannot be thus. Indeed, His Eminence, Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) passed away with success and good fortune like his respected forefathers and in such a condition that his knowledge and will is present with us. And his successor would perform his functions. And except for an unjust criminal, no one has any dispute with us in this matter. And except for a denier disbeliever, no one claims this divine position of ours.

And if it would not have rendered the command of Allah to be subverted and His secret had not been exposed, our right upon you would have become so clear that your intellects would have been amazed and your doubts and uncertainties would have disappeared. However, what Allah has willed, predestined and written would surely happen and nothing except that. Then fear Allah and submit to our affair, and leave this matter with us. And do not persist in seeking that which Allah has concealed and don’t get deviated to the left and right. And make our right and illuminated path as the aim. Indeed, I wish for your well-being and Allah is witness upon you and me.

If I had no affection for you and had not desired mercy and goodness for you, I would not have said anything to you. It is by way of trial and divine test for us that a misguided oppressor, without any right has become a prisoner of his selfish desires and usurped the right of others. Like the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, it is obligatory that I should be patient and in the end the ignorant and tyrant would see the consequences of his deeds.

May Allah Almighty protect you and us from perditions, calamities and evils. And Allah is having authority and power on them and blessings and mercy of Allah be upon all the successors, saints and believers. And may Allah bless Muhammad, the Prophet, and his progeny and peace be upon them.
